t: Seder yom sheni shel rosh hashshana
s: Seder yom sheni shel rosh hashshana ubo b' seipim: beyom sheni mitpalelim shacharit umusap kemo beyom rishon. Veqorin mi"vehaelohim nissa et abraham" ad sop hasseder, kede lehazkir aqedat yitzchaq, umaptir qore battora kemo etmol, umaptir beyirmeya "koh amar vego' ad haben yaqqir vego'", mippene shechobat hayyom lehazkir zikronot ubeoto inyan neemar "zakor ezkerennu od al ken hamu meay vego'":

Ubemotzae rosh hashshana mabdilin ben battepilla ben al hakkos kemo bemotzae shabbat, ella sheen mebarekin al habbesamim veal haesh kemo bishar motzae yom tob, kemo shennitbaer besiman ttz"a ayyen sham:
